COPYING FEES (10 PAGE) PAID BY PLAINTIFF KEDMENEC, CRISTOPHER

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF DEC-07-2018 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF DEC-07-2018 BY CHRISTINE VAN AKEN. PLAINTIFF CHRISTOPHER KEDMENEC IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT NEVEO MOSSER NOT PRESENT. DEFENDANT MOSSER COMPANY IS PRESENT AND REPRESENTED BY CAROL KOHAN, PROPERTY MANAGER. PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN; NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-07-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF KEDMENEC, CRISTOPHER RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MOSSER COMPANIES $6,935.22 PRINCIPAL, $144.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,079.22, DEFENDANT CONCEDES NEGLIGENCE IN THE BOILER REPAIR. PLAINTIFF HAS PROVED BY PREPONDERANCE OF EVIDENCE DAMAGE TO HIS RUG, COUCH, PILLOWS, PLAYSTATION, AND BEDFRAME. THE COURT DOES NOT AWARD RENT OFFSETS IN LIGHT OF DEFENDANT'S PRIOR RENT OFFSET AND DEFENDANT'S PROVISIONS OF A REPLACEMENT APARTMENT. THE NAME OF THE DEFENDANT IS AMENDED TO MOSSER COMPANIES. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS PLAINTIFF'S AND DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
EXHIBITS FROM EXHIBIT REPORT DATED MAR-01-2019 ORDERED DESTROYED
